# Slysh!

> Private, offline Windows desktop speech-to-text workstation powered by GigaAM and Whisper. Zero-bot meeting capture (WASAPI loopback) and YouTube batching.

## Overview
- **Product Name**: Slysh!
- **Primary OS**: Windows 10 & 11 (64-bit)
- **Website**: https://slyshai.pro/
- **Main Repository**: https://github.com/dabder88/slysh
- **Python package**: `slysh` (entrypoint `uv run slysh` / `slysh.app:main`)
- **App Data Directory**: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Slysh`

## Architecture Principles
1. **Process Decoupling**:
   - The UI process (FastAPI + uvicorn + pywebview) **never imports PyTorch or heavy AI models**.
   - Speech inference runs in an isolated engine subprocess (`slysh.engine_server`) communicating over local ephemeral HTTP.
2. **Audio Engines**:
   - Local: Sber GigaAM RNNT/CTC, Faster-Whisper, OpenAI Whisper.
   - Diarization: NVIDIA NeMo (optional extra).
   - Cloud: Groq, Gladia, Deepgram, OpenRouter, custom HTTP, Gemini CLI.
3. **Capture**:
   - Meetings: Windows WASAPI loopback (system audio) + microphone mixed to mono.
4. **Data Layer**:
   - SQLite `app.db` with jobs, segments, speakers, and batch management.
